name: code/tests-node
title: Node test starter
summary: Test starter for Node with node:test: a sample module, table-driven cases and an async case.
when: Use when a Node project has no tests yet and needs a starter showing node:test, table-driven cases and an async case.

name.about: Package name, used in package.json, the temp folder prefix and the README title (lowercase).

next: Write the files, run node --test to confirm the sample tests pass, then replace the sample module and its cases with the project's own code.
